chose: A snip is drawn only from what home hands beside the essay: record:cards takes --snips <dir> (snips.json, some-ui.snips-given/1, and the pictures), checks each picture's hash, and refuses before anything is drawn when a snip is missing or a named part isn't on it. A cut list that still names a snip is refused by resolve(), which every render passes through, so no frame is ever blank. A cards essay may show a snip in place of a card, and its card burn-ins still draw over it as the author wrote them. The whole screen is drawn as the renderer draws any still, fitted into the frame; the device frame or full-bleed 9:16 for phone shots stays the owner's choice (SNIPS4).
options: refuse in resolve() and before recording; a snip in place of a card; the still drawn as any still is
a separate resolved cut-list type the renderer reads, so the compiler refuses an unresolved snip
draw a placeholder for a missing snip
